en.headline: 14 commits in sopen-translate: translation batching and provider docs
en.summary: On 2026-10-23 the user made **14 own commits**, all in `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, plus 20 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, for 14 commits in the overall totals. The `sopen-translate` work focused on performance: batches now follow provider policy with bounded concurrency and adaptive splitting, the batch budget was raised to 8k/400 with **8 lanes** and retries for failed batches, and thinking is disabled per preset or model with a fallback on HTTP 400. Documentation updates covered proxy options for Index-Translate judged by user experience, keyless Bilibili and browser free-translation options (Edge, Google, on-device), and Microsoft Translator with a targeted AI repair phase and a KISS reference boundary; the agent guidance was reconciled with batching, reasoning and real-device testing. The user also added a requirement for a branch workflow with a refreshed E/F execution plan and ignored locally installed agent skills. No pull requests, reviews, issues, releases, stars, replies or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: sopen-translate 提交 14 次：翻译批处理与提供商文档
